from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in this filing")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period end date in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2025-03)")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="Numerical value of Total Assets")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Total Assets (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")
    long_term_debt_value: float | None = Field(description="Numerical value of Long-term Debt")
    long_term_debt_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of Long-term Debt (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[CompanyFinancialData]
